usage: 炸蝦多士 is a noun referring to a type of fried dim sum made with shrimp paste on toast.
You can use 炸蝦多士 to talk about dishes on a dim sum menu.
When ordering food, you can say 我要一份炸蝦多士 to request one order of shrimp toast.
炸蝦多士 is often served as an appetizer or a snack in Cantonese cuisine.
You can also describe the texture by adding adjectives before 炸蝦多士, for example, 香脆炸蝦多士 means crispy shrimp toast.
